G0.title: New-install checklist
lines: one screen of what to fill in now

G1.title: Check 1 · Company profile
lines: industry / offer type / product facts / sender

G2.title: Check 2 · Soul Seven Kit health
lines: missing / empty / unreplaced samples / missing sections

G3.title: Check 3 · User attestation
lines: AI reads back → you reply 'confirmed'

S1.title: Built-in scheduler
lines: runs once a day at a fixed time; exits on 'pause'

S2.title: Check customer pool (customer_db)
lines: sendable cold leads & days of reserve · re-check the day after sending

S3.title: Four-axis replenishment (never all at once)
lines: Depth d1 companies → d2 decision makers → d3 deep-dive
Reach regions near → far · Height tiers high → low
Breadth core → wide → max (slowest)

A1.title: SaaS / customs / CRM exports
lines: drop into inbox → trigger reminds → one import entry

A2.title: Own customer DB import (required)
lines: existing / do-not-contact stay out of cold pool

A3.title: Sending channel
lines: mailbox keys · hosted warm-up · MCP connectors

A4.title: CRM sync
lines: CSV · HubSpot API · MCP (dry run by default)

A5.title: Data Triggers (daily)
lines: outbound always human-approved · bounce anomaly auto-pauses mailbox

N0.title: Step 0 · Omni-channel Review
lines: win patterns + WA review + last week's kit write-back
MEMORY 'this week's conclusions' = start of this round

N1.title: Step 1 · Search Candidates (public search only)
lines: keyword matrix · 15 discovery channels (incl. no-signup customs path)
10 social platforms public search + 30 procurement-chain titles

T1.title: #1 Check the DB first
lines: keep only truly new; without --against = warning only

T2.title: #2 Funnel diagnosis
lines: per-stage + cumulative conversion; watch trends

T3.title: #3 Pending into pool
lines: wide entry, strict sending: no named mailbox → pending@
named mailbox required before sending

N2.title: Step 2 · Background Research (core, never skip)
lines: 5 sources + 3 research questions; brand name ≠ need
each conclusion tagged S1 / S2 / S3 + source URL

NR.title: Tag need_review → user decides
lines: AI draws no conclusion; thin info → need_tag=unknown
use the conservative generic line, confirm in follow-up

N3.title: Step 3 · Need Positioning (dual tags)
lines: need_tag → which line · solution_tag → which hook
violates positioning.tag_rules → no send, to human

N4.title: Step 4 · Write Content
lines: recipient's native language · ≤120 words · plain text
S1/S2 facts only · follow-ups change angle, add news

N5.title: Step 5 · Send
lines: DRY_RUN preview → user approval → named decision maker
recipient's local business window · ≤200/day · 30s interval

WB.title: Outside local window → defer
lines: report deferred_window, no history row

SB.title: Safety & compliance baseline
lines: credentials via env vars only · 465/587 encrypted
send / bounce scan / DNS / WA all have dry run
generic mailbox block · bounce = permanent blacklist · read-only
social scripts emit public queries only; login / DMs manual

N6.title: Step 6 · Follow-up Management
lines: 24–48h bounce / reply scan (read-only mailbox, DRY_RUN first)
social DMs (manual) 1-3-7-21; one channel per day

B1.title: Bounce
lines: mark_bounced: blacklist + stop for good
→ back to pool for replenishment

B2.title: Reply → human follow-up
lines: quotes / lead times / replies need user approval
explicit refusal → add_blacklist, stop all channels

B3.title: No reply → 5-level cooldown
lines: followup_count = e-mails sent − 1

B4.title: Order / won
lines: AI proposes evidenced pain-point candidates only
stored only after user confirmation → Step 8

L.title: Stop generic mailboxes → LinkedIn / personal only
lines: manual · social 1-3-7-21; Day 21 no reply → check WA signals

W1.title: WA trigger signals (any one)
lines: ≥3 e-mails no reply · bounced, no alternative
high value + public WA · customer gave number

W2.title: List → bulk-send input
lines: wa_targets.json / CSV → contacts JSON

W3.title: Validate + read-only preview
lines: numbers / duplicates / empty / placeholders
fail → fix list or template, convert again

W4.title: Test-number send
lines: only to your own test number

W5.title: One-by-one bulk send (anti-ban rules)
lines: screenshot check · 8–15s interval · 200 → STOP

W6.title: Screenshot audit
lines: undelivered / wrong person → check individually

W7.title: Write back + won channel
lines: wa_status=sent · add_success --won_channel wa

W8.title: WA dedicated review (read-only)
lines: funnel + by region / need / hook

R1.title: Store success case
lines: pain point = user-confirmed version

R2.title: Omni-channel review
lines: by region / need_tag / hook_type / channel

R3.title: Weekly kit write-back
lines: wrong / missed / overreach → attribute to one file
fix the rule, not the sentence; update HEARTBEAT

R4.title: Re-check → next round
lines: write conclusions into MEMORY

RX.title: Win attribution (won_channel)
lines: e-mail vs WA: which channel wins more
→ weight channels / regions / hooks next round
customs, social etc. counted by source_channel

DL.title: Data layer (throughout · send records only via csv_ops.py)
lines: customer_db · sent_history · blacklist · wa_contacts · success_cases · pipeline · mailbox_usage · crm_sync_log  |  before: check / cross_brand_check · after: add_sent · bounce: mark_bounced
Iron rule: scripts never edit customer data by themselves; pain points, tags, sending, CRM push and quotes are user decisions; keys via env vars only
